audience: freelancers and agencies who write client proposals in Bidsketch

useCases.title: Check which proposals are viewed, accepted or declined
useCases.text: The AI lists all proposals with status, draft flag and dates, or only the proposals of one client, and summarizes what still needs a follow-up.

useCases.title: Read a proposal's content and price
useCases.text: The AI reads a proposal's sections and fees in order, with fee subtotals, total, tax and discount, so you can review it before it goes out.

useCases.title: Look up, add or update a client
useCases.text: The AI lists clients with email and phone, opens one with address and notes, creates a client, or changes fields of an existing one.

useCases.title: Create a draft proposal from a template
useCases.text: The AI picks a template, reads its saved sections and fees, and creates a draft proposal for a client with a copy of them. Nothing is sent to the client.

useCases.title: Edit the sections and fees of a proposal
useCases.text: The AI adds or changes text sections (opening or closing) and fee lines of a proposal. Fixed, hourly, monthly and yearly fees change the price.

useCases.title: Save reusable fees and text sections
useCases.text: The AI lists the saved fees and sections and creates new ones for later proposals. They are not added to any proposal.
